Name: QuietTownTrees
Author: Malenyaaa
Description:
Description
Since 1.6, hitting one of the trees along the paths in Pelican Town with your axe pops up a message box: "I shouldn't cut down trees in town." When you're swinging your axe around town, that box gets in the way every time.

This mod removes the message. The town trees still can't be cut down: your axe just bounces off with the usual chop sound and the tree shakes, like before. Nothing else changes.

If you want to actually cut the town trees down, use Chop Town Trees instead.

Config: edit config.json (created on first launch) or use Generic Mod Config Menu.
- Enabled (default: on): hides the town tree message. Turn it off to get the message back.

Compatibility:
- Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+
- Works in multiplayer and split-screen. Each player only needs it if they want the message gone for themselves.
- Translations: English, German.

Installation instructions
1. Install SMAPI.
2. Unzip the mod into your Mods folder.
3. Start the game through SMAPI.

Main features
- No more "I shouldn't cut down trees in town" message
- Town trees stay protected, the axe bounces off quietly
- Can be turned off any time in the config or Generic Mod Config Menu

Requirements
- SMAPI (required)
- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, only to change the setting in-game)

Shout outs
Thanks to the r/StardewValleyMods post that asked for this.

AI disclosure: This mod was made with the help of an AI coding assistant (Claude by Anthropic). I came up with the idea, decided how it should behave, tested it in-game and reviewed the result. The AI wrote most of the code.

Source code (MIT): https://github.com/Malenyaaa/stardew-mods
